row.evidence: Proof's pricing page lists "Proof Command Center (Admin, SSO, SCIM)" only under Premium & Enterprise ("Custom pricing"), above Pro ($0/month) and Pro+ ($199/month) plus transaction fees.
row.notes: New row. Proof (proof.com, formerly Notarize) prices Pro at $0/month and Pro+ at $199/month (flat platform fees, monthly, plus per-transaction fees), so per-user fields are null; Premium & Enterprise is custom-priced. SSO and SCIM come with Proof Command Center on Premium & Enterprise; the SSO guide says Command Center can also be purchased separately (price not public). SCIM 2.0 schemas at https://api.proof.com/scim/v1/organizations/{organization_id} with the Proof API key: Users (create, get, list with userName filter, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, active=false), ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas, ResourceTypes; no Groups; roles owner/admin/employee via the roles attribute. SAML JIT provisioning is also available. Not found in the Okta OIN or Entra gallery. Security events API (OCSF) needs Command Center.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat platform fee, not per user; per-transaction fees apply.

plans.name: Pro+
plans.notes: Adds API access (transaction API); SSO/SCIM not listed.

plans.name: Premium & Enterprise
plans.notes: Includes Proof Command Center (Admin, SSO, SCIM); the SSO guide also allows a separately purchased Command Center.

auth.token_source: Proof API key sent in the ApiKey header (ServiceProviderConfig describes it as an API key bearer header)

endpoints.notes: ResourceTypes returns only User; Schemas is exposed at /Schemas/Users.

operations.notes: Path is /scim/v1/... but payloads use urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User. Reactivation inferred from the writable active attribute.

deprovision.notes: active=false marks the identity deprovisioned; DELETE /Users/{user_id} also exists (204).

roles.how: roles attribute (primary only): owner, admin or employee; PATCH add/replace on roles

limitations.text: Only the primary email and primary role are supported.
No Groups resource; bulk not supported.
An organization member cannot delete themselves via SCIM.

audit_log_api.notes: List Security Events returns OCSF-format security events; requires Command Center access.

user_api.notes: Apart from SCIM, the Proof API (API access from Pro+) covers transactions, documents, webhooks, organizations and verifiable credentials; no non-SCIM user/team-member endpoints are listed in llms.txt. False is by absence.

entra.notes: No Proof or Notarize entry in the Entra SaaS tutorial index (toc.json).
